notes: 2026-07-10: removed dead .book-stage-review and .review-chapter-rail* rules (the rail they styled no longer renders, BoothTool doesn't port it). .review-main/.review-main__*/.review-text-view* kept — BoothTool/index.tsx still uses them as-is.

2026-07-10: Warning #4 (reading surface): `.review-text-view` now uses `var(--font-reading)` + `var(--surface-reading)`; `.review-text-view__segment` uses `var(--type-reading)`/`var(--leading-reading)` instead of a flat 0.75rem UI-font size. Warning #6 (low-contrast active highlight): added a non-color `border-left: 3px solid var(--accent)` gutter bar to `.review-text-view__segment--active` alongside the existing tint/weight change. Added `.review-text-view__segment--pulse` + `@keyframes booth-autoplay-pulse` for the one-shot autoplay acknowledgment, with a `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` override disabling the animation (matching the existing `.switch__knob` convention in this file).

2026-07-10: CRITICAL #2 (resting-state/touch affordance): `.revise-text-view__segment` gained a persistent `border-left: 2px solid var(--border-muted)` so extent/clickability is visible before any interaction; `:hover`/`:focus-within` now also intensify `border-color`/`border-left-color` to `var(--border)` (previously background-wash only) and reveal the new `.revise-text-view__edit-icon` (opacity 0→1, transition-based, not color-only). Warning #3 (segment vs. paragraph boundaries): reduced `.revise-text-view`'s inter-segment `gap` from 8px to 3px so consecutive same-paragraph segments read less like separate paragraphs, while the border-left tick keeps individual segment extents legible. Warning #6 (token pairing): `.revise-text-view__save-btn` now pairs `color: var(--on-action)` with `background: var(--accent)`, matching `.btn-primary`'s `--action-primary`/`--on-action` convention (was incorrectly paired with `var(--surface)`). Added `.revise-tool__hint` (quiet caption style, `var(--text-muted)`, 0.7rem) for the new topbar hint.
